pages.title: Material Tiers
pages.text: SteamCraft adds new materials organised in tiers. Start with $(bold)Plastic$() for cheap early tools. Move up to $(bold)Steel$() for tougher equipment. You will also need $(bold)Copper$() components and $(bold)Electronics$() to build advanced machines.

pages.title: The Crafting Chain
pages.text: Everything starts from raw resources. The $(bold)Tree Tap$() gives you Rubber Sap. A furnace turns sap into Rubber, then Rubber into Plastic Sheet. A $(bold)Blast Furnace$() turns Iron into Steel. Use a $(bold)Stonecutter$() to slice ingots and plates into rods and flat sheets.
